summary: Combine explicit topic boundaries, durable checkpoints and age-aware telemetry so session reuse can adapt to the local workload.

items.text: Compact the active context at topic boundaries, retaining the new objective and durable shared facts while retiring topic-local residue.
Store decisions that must survive a reset outside the conversation so a fresh session does not have to rediscover them.
Use explicit context entry points to make a reset cheap and to reduce variation in orientation latency.
Segment TE results by task similarity: shared-repository microtasks should not be pooled with unrelated or high-risk topic switches.
